lines.zh: 霍斯站定在台角，没有动
lines.en: Foxy holds his corner of the stage.
His hook hangs at his side.
He leans as if about to charge.

lines.zh: 他的脚被钉在展示架上
lines.en: His feet are fixed to the display.
He can only shuffle a little.
His tail drags behind him.

lines.zh: 他的钩子轻轻碰了下栏杆
lines.en: His hook taps the railing.
He turns side-on, weight forward.
He takes half a step and stops.

lines.zh: 他的皮套在关节处绷紧了
lines.en: His covering pulls tight at the joints.
He seems to wait for the curtain.
His head points at the corridor.
Foxy tilts his head, eyes half-lit.
His hook turns slowly.
His jaw hangs slack, teeth showing.
One of his ears is torn.

lines.zh: 他的尾巴尖抽动了一下
lines.en: His tail tip twitches.
Parts rattle inside him.
He looks down at his hook.
Old splits mark his covering.
He straightens abruptly.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛闪了一下红光
lines.en: A red glint crosses his eyes.
He raises the hook to empty air.
He lowers it, slowly.
What serves as breathing is a motor.

lines.zh: 他像在听走廊尽头的声音
lines.en: He seems to listen down the corridor.
Foxy cocks his head and fixes on you.
His hook comes up to waist height.
His teeth catch the light.
His eyes keep jittering.

lines.zh: 他站得比你高，影子压下来
lines.en: He stands taller; his shadow falls on you.
He lowers his head low.
The covering splits at his shoulder.

lines.zh: 他朝你的方向偏了半步
lines.en: He tilts half a step your way.

lines.zh: 他的喉咙里发出一声干响
lines.en: A dry rasp comes from his throat.
He does not lunge; he only watches.

lines.zh: 他的钩子在空中划了半圈
lines.en: The hook makes half a circle in the air.
He seems to estimate how fast you are.
His head drifts toward the corridor.

lines.zh: 他的脚始终没挪出原位
lines.en: His feet never leave their marks.

lines.zh: 他忽然笑了一下，声音很干
lines.en: He laughs, dry and short.
His eyes settle on your chest.
He can neither retreat nor advance.

lines.zh: 他就那么站着，等你走动
lines.en: He simply stands, waiting for you to move.
Foxy is struck and the hook swings.
His covering tears wider.
The frame shows through.
His head hangs to one side.
He cannot retreat; he only shudders.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛闪了两下红光
lines.en: His eyes flash red twice.
His jaw shakes hard.
A screw rolls off the stage.
His tail drops.

lines.zh: 他慢慢把头摆正，继续站着
lines.en: He levels his head and keeps standing.

lines.zh: 霍斯盯着你手里的东西
lines.en: Foxy stares at what you hold.

lines.zh: 他用钩子把它勾了过来
lines.en: He hooks it over to himself.
He dips his head and sniffs.

lines.zh: 他把东西夹在钩子上转
lines.en: He spins it on the hook.

lines.zh: 他没有嘴去咬，只是拿着
lines.en: He has no working bite; he just holds it.
He hangs it on the railing.

lines.zh: 他的耳朵朝前立了一下
lines.en: An ear pricks forward.
He puts a hand out for another.
He hides it behind himself.
His eyes brighten a notch.

lines.zh: 你撞上霍斯，他前倾了一下
lines.en: You hit Foxy and he tips forward.

lines.zh: 他的钩子扫过你的手臂
lines.en: His hook sweeps your arm.

lines.zh: 他稳住身体，钩子还在晃
lines.en: He steadies; the hook still swings.

lines.zh: 他被撞得退不出，只能歪
lines.en: He cannot step back, only list.
His tail slaps your leg.
You slip past his flank.

lines.zh: 他的头随撞击甩向一边
lines.en: His head snaps aside from the knock.
A creak comes from under the covering.
He slowly brings himself upright.

lines.zh: 他继续站着，像没被碰过
lines.en: He keeps standing as if untouched.

lines.zh: 霍斯和另一具玩偶站在台角
lines.en: Foxy stands with another animatronic in the corner.

lines.zh: 两具身体都朝同一条走廊
lines.en: Both face the same corridor.

lines.zh: 他们的头同时歪了一下
lines.en: Their heads tilt at once.

lines.zh: 他们的钩子和托盘并排
lines.en: Hook and tray side by side.

lines.zh: 同一套程序让他们同步
lines.en: One routine keeps them in step.
Their eyes light together.

lines.zh: 灰尘在他们之间积成一条线
lines.en: Dust gathers in a line between them.

lines.zh: 他们没有交流，也不需要
lines.en: They do not communicate, nor need to.
They keep their post until morning.

lines.zh: 这段程序里没有别的东西
lines.en: That routine holds nothing else.

lines.zh: 霍斯用钩子把东西勾起来
lines.en: Foxy hooks the item up.

lines.zh: 他把它提到眼前看了看
lines.en: He brings it to his eyes.
He pinches up a second one.

lines.zh: 他把东西挂上腰间的环
lines.en: He hangs it on a ring at his waist.
What he rejects, he flicks off the stage.

lines.zh: 他弯腰时皮套绷得很响
lines.en: Bending, his covering creaks loudly.
He lines the items up.

lines.zh: 他的钩子卡住了，抖了两下
lines.en: The hook jams and twitches twice.
He pins it under a foot.

lines.zh: 收好后，他的头又转向走廊
lines.en: Done, his head turns back to the corridor.
Foxy's head snaps around.
His hook rises past his shoulder.
His eyes go full red.
He drops low as if to pounce.
His jaw opens to its widest.
The motor's whine spikes.
He starts leaning your way.

lines.zh: 他的尾巴绷成一条直线
lines.en: His tail goes rigid.

lines.zh: 他一步也迈不出，僵在那儿
lines.en: He cannot step; he freezes there.
The hook halts in the air.

lines.zh: 他把你当成了跑掉的那个
lines.en: He takes you for the one who got away.

lines.zh: 他的身体抖得越来越快
lines.en: His trembling quickens.

lines.zh: 他张着嘴，等一个开演的时机
lines.en: Jaw open, he waits for the cue.

lines.zh: 他的目光钉死了你的脚
lines.en: His stare nails your feet.
The corridor lights start flickering.
He is ready.

lines.zh: 霍斯一直朝你的方向倾
lines.en: Foxy keeps leaning your way.
His hook stays raised.
His head turns with you.

lines.zh: 他的脚在地板上蹭了半寸
lines.en: His feet scrape half an inch.

lines.zh: 他试着往前，被架子拦住
lines.en: He tries forward and the frame holds him.

lines.zh: 他的牙齿一直露在外面
lines.en: His teeth stay bared.
His eyes pulse bright and dim.

lines.zh: 他把头歪到奇怪的角度
lines.en: His head cants at a strange angle.
His motion comes in skipped frames.
His shadow sways at your feet.
Then he goes completely still.

lines.zh: 那种安静更让人后背发凉
lines.en: That quiet crawls up your back.
He lowers the hook by degrees.

lines.zh: 他的头压低到胸口高度
lines.en: His head drops to chest height.

lines.zh: 他在数你离门还有几步
lines.en: He is counting your steps to the door.

lines.zh: 他的皮套在肩头又裂了一点
lines.en: The covering splits a little more.
He is waiting for you to turn.
He has not moved, and has not given up.
Foxy's hook sweeps across.

lines.zh: 他扑前一步，被架子扯住
lines.en: He lunges a step and the frame jerks him back.

lines.zh: 他的牙咬在你的护甲上
lines.en: His teeth clamp on your armour.
He hooks your collar.
A shove with real force.
His tail lashes your knee.
Savage, and yet mechanical.
The hook tip grazes your ribs.

lines.zh: 他咬空了一次，牙磕得很响
lines.en: He bites air; teeth clack loudly.
The hook snags on the railing.
He wrenches it free after two pulls.
The second swing comes in lower.

lines.zh: 他的动作带起一股陈旧的味
lines.en: The swing carries a stale smell.

lines.zh: 他收回钩子，喘着电机声
lines.en: He pulls it back, motor rasping.

lines.zh: 他停在半途，又开始发抖
lines.en: He halts halfway and starts shaking.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛一直没从你身上移开
lines.en: His eyes never leave you.
The light at the corridor's end comes on.
Foxy stands by the curtain.
His hook catches the light.
His covering is pulled taut.
His head turns your way first.
Joints click into place one by one.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛亮起两点红光
lines.en: Two red points light in his eyes.

lines.zh: 他把钩子举起来试了试
lines.en: He raises the hook and tests it.
Dust slides off his shoulder.

lines.zh: 他往前迈了半步就停下
lines.en: He takes half a step and halts.

lines.zh: 他的尾巴在地上扫了一下
lines.en: His tail sweeps the floor once.
He seems to wait for the audience to hush.

lines.zh: 幕布后传来轻微的响动
lines.en: A small sound comes from behind the curtain.
He lowers himself a little.
And then he stops moving.
Those red eyes stay lit.

lines.zh: 他的旧裂口在灯下很清楚
lines.en: The old splits show clearly.
He begins tonight's watch.
The covering burns and he keeps moving.

lines.zh: 掉落时他砸在台下，钩子弯了
lines.en: He crashes below the stage, hook bent.
Water fills him and the red eyes go out.
The blast throws him into the curtain.
An arrow pins into his chest.
Odd force passes through; the motor screeches.

lines.zh: 电量见底，他的动作更僵
lines.en: Low power makes his motion stiffer.

lines.zh: 雷击让他整个人抽了一下
lines.en: Lightning convulses him.

lines.zh: 虚空吸住他，钩子抓不到东西
lines.en: The void pulls; the hook finds nothing.
